en: PDFs, arXiv papers, and webpages become Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM) notebooks with audio overviews, slides, and study materials.
ko: PDF, arXiv 논문, 웹페이지를 대기열에 추가해 Gemini Notebook(NotebookLM) 노트북과 AI 오디오 오버뷰, 슬라이드, 학습 자료를 생성합니다.
ja: Scholar Relay - Gemini Notebook（NotebookLM）の自動化
PDF、arXiv 論文、Web ページをキューに追加し、Gemini Notebook（NotebookLM）のノートブック、音声解説、スライド、学習資料を生成します。
es: Scholar Relay - Automatización de Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)

fr: Scholar Relay - Automatisation de Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)

de: Scholar Relay - Automatisierung für Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM)
